title: Multilingual OCR-Aware Fine-Tuning and Prompt-Guided Chain-of-Thought Reasoning for Multimodal Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.16409v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Optical character recognition (OCR) and multilingual scene-text understanding remain challenging for multimodal large language models (MLLMs), particularly in real-world images containing small or degraded text, cluttered layouts, occlusion, handwriting, and complex typography. We present an OCR-aware multilingual post-training framework that improves visual-text grounding in a general-purpose MLLM without requiring an external OCR engine, OCR-extracted text, or text bounding boxes at inference time. The framework combines large-scale multilingual OCR supervision, approximately 5M additional multilingual training samples, controlled synthetic OCR generation and in-image text translation, LoRA-based supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and lightweight OCR-oriented Chain-of-Thought prompting. translated_title: 面向多语言大语言模型的OCR感知微调与提示引导的思维链推理
translated_abstract: 光学字符识别（OCR）和多语言场景文本理解对多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）仍具挑战性，尤其是在包含小尺寸或退化文本、杂乱布局、遮挡、手写和复杂排版的真实世界图像中。我们提出了一种OCR感知的多语言后训练框架，在不依赖外部OCR引擎、OCR提取文本或推理时文本边界框的情况下，提升通用MLLM的视觉-文本基础能力。该框架结合了大规模多语言OCR监督、约500万个额外的多语言训练样本、受控的合成OCR生成和图像内文本翻译、基于LoRA的监督微调（SFT），以及轻量级的面向OCR的思维链提示。在一个保留的真实世界多语言OCR基准上，OCR-SFT将OCR完整性从71.3提高到84.6，并将幻觉率从18.3\%降至较低水平。
tldr: 本文提出了一种无需外部OCR引擎的多语言后训练框架，通过大规模监督、合成数据和思维链提示，显著提升了多模态大语言模型的OCR完整性和降低幻觉率。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an OCR-aware multilingual post-training framework that enhances multimodal LLMs' visual-text grounding without external OCR engines, improving OCR completeness and reducing hallucinations.
